title: Profiling & Benchmarking
description: Learn to profile .NET applications, use BenchmarkDotNet for micro-benchmarks, and identify performance bottlenecks.

data.text: Use dotnet-counters for real-time metrics, dotnet-trace for detailed tracing, and Visual Studio Profiler for deep analysis. Identify CPU, memory, and I/O bottlenecks.

data.title: BenchmarkDotNet Example
Key Takeaways
points: Profile before optimizing - measure, don't guess
BenchmarkDotNet provides reliable micro-benchmarks with statistical analysis
Look for hot paths, memory allocations, and I/O bottlenecks
data.takeaway: Performance optimization requires measurement. Use profiling tools to identify actual bottlenecks before optimizing. BenchmarkDotNet is the gold standard for .NET micro-benchmarks.
